title: Quaestiones Veteris et Novi Testamenti (Questions on the Old and New Testament) / «Вопросы Ветхого и Нового Завета»
author: Ambrosiaster (anonymous Roman cleric; transmitted under Augustine's name)
size: 127 questions (recension III; 150 in recension I); est. 110–130k words
edition: Souter, CSEL 50 (1908), public domain; also PL 35. Q.114–115: Bussières, SC 512 (2007)
ru_evidence: azbyka.ru/otechnik/Amvrosiast lists Latin originals only. ru.wikipedia 'Амброзиастер' cites only Pauline-commentary excerpts in the Russian ACCS series (Библейские комментарии отцов Церкви)
en_evidence: Only a self-published, non-peer-reviewed version: J. Litteral, CreateSpace 2018, 452 pp. (Open Library). No scholarly English translation found.
other_translations: French: Q.114–115 (SC 512, 2007). German: Q.115 (von Queis 1972). No complete scholarly translation found.
value: Late-4th-century Rome through a learned cleric's eyes. Q.114 'Against the pagans' (incl. Mithraic initiation) and Q.115 'On fate' (astrology); also Roman law, Jews, women, Novatianists, Manichees. A core source for the religion and society of late-antique Rome.
ai_feasibility: high: plain argumentative Latin and a public-domain critical text. Challenges: differences between recensions; legal and astrological terms.
pilot_unit: Q.114 Adversus paganos + Q.115 De fato; est. 14–16k words
